course.title: Project Management and Entrepreneurship
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: You are a financial analyst for Dantor Ltd. You have two project proposals Project-A and (25) Project-B. Each project has a cost of \$10,000 and cost of capital for each project is 12%. The projects expected cash flows are as follows:
(i) Calculate projects' payback period and net present value.
(ii) Calculate Internal Rate of Return (IRR) of the projects.
(iii) Which project should be accepted and why?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
